title: Post-EVA dizziness on standing
trigger_patterns: engine level is watch or higher within six hours after an EVA
the crew member reports dizziness or light-headedness on standing after an EVA
resting heart rate sits above the personal band after an EVA

steps.text: Sit down as soon as you are out of the suit. Do not stand up straight away.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Ask a crew mate to stay with you for the next 15 minutes.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Measure heart rate and blood pressure lying down, then again after one minute standing.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Log both readings and note whether you felt dizzy.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: If you feel light-headed, sit or lie down again at once and tell your buddy.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Drink and eat according to the EVA recovery checklist.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: If the standing reading stays abnormal, open the onboard medical protocol for orthostatic symptoms.
steps.source: onboard medical protocol - no drug doses are shown in LIGHTMINUTE

steps.text: Send the readings to Earth. A reply may take longer than the symptoms last.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure

steps.text: Escalate now if: fainting, chest pain, vision changes, or a fall.
steps.source: LIGHTMINUTE demo wording - not a NASA procedure
